senses.gloss: अध अ + ध (cf. अधस्), a particle. There, then, Lass. Anth. 98, 14 = Rigv. 5, 9, 5.

अधम अधम (an old superlative, akin to अधस्), adj., f. मा. Extremely low, Man. 6, 65. In Karmadhāraya compounds it is generally the latter part: e. g. द्विज-, m. the meanest of twice-born men, Man. 3, 140; नर-, m. the lowest of mortals, Man. 10, 26; पाप-, m. the lowest of the wicked; पार्थिव-, m. the meanest of kings; पुरुष-, m. the vilest of men; शशक-, m. the vilest of hares.
 --Cf. Lat. infimus.
अधमर्ण अधमर्ण, i. e. अधम-ऋण, m. A debtor, Man. 8, 47.
अधमर्णिक अधमर्णिक, i. e. अधमर्ण + इक, m. A debtor, Man. 8, 48.

अधर अधर (an old comparative, akin to अधस्).
 I. adj., f. रा. Lower, [] inferior.
 II. m.
 1. The lower lip Śāk. 102, 10.
 2. The lip in general, Śiś. 9, 46.
 --Comp.
 --Cf. Lat. inferus; Goth. undar; A.S. under; probably ἔνεροι.

आधार आधार, i. e. आ-धृ + अ, m.
 1. A prop, support, Rām. 5, 3, 77; Vedāntas. in Chr. 202, 4.
 2. A canal, Yājñ. 3, 144.
 3. A basin round the foot of a tree, Śāk. d. 14.
 4. A dike, Ragh. 5, 6.
 --Comp.

अधरोष्ठ अधरोष्ठ, and अधरौष्ठ अधरौष्ठ, i. e. अधर-ओष्ठ, m.
 1. The lower lip, Suśr. 1, 114, 19.
 2. The lower and the upper lips, the lips, Pañc. 45, 11.
 --Comp.

अधस् अ + धस् (cf. इदम्).
 I. adv.
 1. Underneath.
 2. Low, Man. 11, 224.
 3. Down, Pañc. i. d. 214; to hell, Man. 7, 53.
 II. prepos. Under, with the gen., Man. 2, 59, and abl. Pañc. 115, 25.
 III. doubled: अधोधस्, i. e. अधस्-अधस्, adv.
 1. Lower and lower, Man. 7, 53.
 2. One below the other.
 --Cf. ἔνθεν, and see अधर.

अधस्तात् अधस्-तात् (the latter part is the original abl. of तद्).
 I. adv.
 1. Underneath, below.
 2. Down, downward, Man. 4, 54; to hell, 194.
 II. prepos. Under, with the gen.
 III. latter part of comp. adv. Under, Pañc. 141, 20.

आधमन आधमन, i. e. आ-ध्मा + अन, n. A pledge, Man. 8, 165.
 --Comp.

आधान आधान, i. e. आ-धा + अन, n.
 1. Adding, Man. 2, 176. 2. Preparing the holy fire, MBh. 3, 8194.
 3. Lighting the nuptial fire, Man. 5, 186.
 4. Conception, Megh. 3.
 5. Pledging, Yājñ. 2, 238.
 6. Using, Ragh. 1, 24.
 --Comp.
अ- + धन अ- + धन, adj., f. ना. 1. having no property, Man. 8, 416. 2. poor, Rām. 1, 15, 18.
आधायक आधायक, i. e. आ-धा + अक, adj. Bestowing.

अधर- + उत्तर अधर- + उत्तर,
 I. adj. 1. lower and higher, Yājñ. 1, 96. 2. confused, Man. 8, 53.
 II. n. a state of confusion, topsy-turvy, Man. 7, 21; useless discussion, Śāk. 69, 17.
अधस्- + तल अधस्- + तल, m. or n. that which is under anything, Pañc. 187, 5.
अ- + धर्म अ- + धर्म, m. 1. wrong, Man. 1, 26. 2. unjust way, Man. 2, 111. 3. demerit, Bhāṣāp. 160.
अ- + धर्मिष्ठ अ- + धर्मिष्ठ, adj. 1. unjust, Rām. 2, 23, 13. 2. very wicked, MBh. 1, 4579.
अ- + धर्म्य अ- + धर्म्य, adj. 1. illegal, Man. 3, 25. 2. unjust, Rām. 1, 27, 18.
अ- + धारणक अ- + धारणक, adj. unsupportable.
अ- + धार्मिक अ- + धार्मिक, adj. 1. unobservant of one's duties, Man. 4, 61. 2. where the duties are neglected, Man. 4, 60.
अ-धर्म- + परवन्त् अ-धर्म- + परवन्त्, i. e. अ-धर्म-पर + वन्त्, adj. become a prey to injustice, Rām. 5, 45, 17.
अधःपाद अधःपाद, i. e. अधस्-, m. the sole of the feet, Pañc. 165, 16.
अधर- + पुट अधर- + पुट and ओष्ठ-, m. or n. the cup-like lips, Śṛṅgārat. 7; Śāk. d. 182 (in a comp. adj. having pale-red cup-like lips).

आधार-आ-धेय- + भाव आधार-आ-धेय- + भाव (vb. धा), m. state or relation of the receptacle and the object received, Hit. iii. d. 12 (instr. because it [viz. the mirror] can receive [reflect] only in proportion to its greatness).

अ-धःशय्य अ-धःशय्य, i. e. अधस्-,
 I. adj. sleeping on the ground, Rām. 5, 66, 13.
 II. f. या, sleeping on a low bed, Man. 2, 108.
